description: Reference email-provider plugin demonstrating BOTH transports in one plugin: OAuth 2.0 (preferred) an' SMTP/IMAP with an app-password (fallback). The mode be chosen from the stored credentials. Use it as a template fer hybrid providers or to see how SMTP/IMAP an' OAuth each work. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects fer hidden recipients an' enforces the recipient at send time.
